target.title: fix(scripts): bound check-media-download-helper git operations
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the check-media-download-helper-roundtrip script could hang indefinitely when listing tracked extension sources. The `execFileSync("git", ...)` call in `listTrackedExtensionSources` would block without any timeout during git operations.

## Why This Change Was Made

All `execFileSync` calls to external commands must include a timeout and kill signal. Without these, transient git issues cause resource leaks and indefinite stalls. This follows the same bounding pattern applied in #110599 and #110814.

## User Impact

Media download helper roundtrip checking can complete or fail-fast within a bounded deadline instead of blocking indefinitely.

## Evidence

- Adds `MEDIA_CHECK_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000` constant and applies `timeout` + `killSignal: "SIGKILL"` to the `execFileSync("git", ...)` call site.
- Pattern consistency: matches the bounding approach in `scripts/changed-lanes.mjs` (#110814).
